title: Employment Permits Act 2024
verified_how: Act number found in the eISB 2024 listing. Enacted page title: 'Employment Permits Act 2024'. Directory entry: ss. 1-2, 4-8 and others commenced 2 Sep 2024 (S.I. No. 443 of 2024) and s. 3(1)(c) on 19 Feb 2025 (S.I. No. 32 of 2025). The directory entry for the 2006 Act shows 'Act repealed with transitional provisions' by 17/2024 from 2 Sep 2024.
notes: Replaces the Employment Permits Act 2006 (No. 16 of 2006), which was repealed with transitional provisions.
